# mod.json

The manifest at the root of a mod folder or `.carinamod`: `{ "$schema": "carina-mod/1", ... }`. The table is generated from the schema the importer checks, so it is the same list `npx carina-modkit check` enforces. Schema: [mod schema](../schemas/mod.schema.json).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$schema` | the text `carina-mod/1` | yes | the format id; it must stay, whatever your editor maps it to |
| `id` | mod id, 4 to 64 characters | yes | author.slug: lowercase letters and digits, inner hyphens; the carina. prefix is reserved; never change it after release: saves and dependencies name the mod by it |
| `version` | text | yes | semver: bump it with every release |
| `format` | the number `1` | yes | package format; this game reads 1 |
| `rulesVersion` | integer >= 1 | yes | bump when saves made with an older version need a migration; see [Releasing an update](https://jkirsteins.github.io/carina-mod-template/guide/updates) |
| `phase` | one of `content`, `patch`, `final` | yes | content (adds things), patch (changes things), final (last word) |
| `title` | text, up to 40 characters | yes | 1-40 printable Latin-1 characters; Latin-1 only, because the game's bitmap fonts have no other glyphs |
| `summary` | text, up to 200 characters | no | up to 200 printable Latin-1 characters |
| `authors` | list of 1 to 8 object (fields below) | yes |  |
| `authors[].name` | text, up to 40 characters | yes | author name |
| `authors[].url` | https URL | no |  |
| `license` | text | yes | an SPDX licence expression, for example CC-BY-4.0 |
| `sources` | list of up to 64 object (fields below) | no | outside material in the package: which files, who made them, under which licence |
| `sources[].files` | text matching `^[A-Za-z0-9._*/-]{1,200}$` | yes (when `sources` is given) | a package path; `*` matches in a name |
| `sources[].author` | text, up to 40 characters | yes (when `sources` is given) | the source's author |
| `sources[].license` | text | yes (when `sources` is given) | an SPDX licence expression, for example CC-BY-4.0 |
| `sources[].url` | https URL | no |  |
| `aiUse` | list of up to 3 values, each one of `graphics`, `sound`, `text` (no repeats) | no | what in this mod was made with generative AI |
| `allowFeature` | true or false | no | the project may feature this mod in marketing, with credit |
| `allowEmbed` | true or false | no | shared saves may embed this mod's rules and text; a player without the mod can then load such a shared save |
| `basedOn` | list of up to 16 text matching `^[0-9a-f]{64}$` (no repeats) | no | package hashes of the mods this one remixes; the `packageHash` values that `check` prints |
| `game` | object (fields below) | no | outside these ranges `check` warns `untested-kernel` or `untested-base`; the mod still loads |
| `game.kernel` | text | no | a version range: `*`, `1.2.3`, `^1.2.0`, `~1.2.0`, `>=1.0.0 <2.0.0` |
| `game.base` | text | no | a version range: `*`, `1.2.3`, `^1.2.0`, `~1.2.0`, `>=1.0.0 <2.0.0` |
| `dependencies` | list of up to 32 object (fields below) | no |  |
| `dependencies[].id` | mod id, 4 to 64 characters | yes (when `dependencies` is given) |  |
| `dependencies[].range` | text | no | a version range: `*`, `1.2.3`, `^1.2.0`, `~1.2.0`, `>=1.0.0 <2.0.0`; default `*` |
| `dependencies[].kind` | one of `required`, `optional`, `incompatible` | yes (when `dependencies` is given) | `required`: absent gives `missing-dependency`, out of range `dependency-version`, and switching the mod on in RULES switches the required mods on; `optional`: absent does nothing, present must be in range, and it loads first; `incompatible`: present and in range is the error `incompatible` |
| `loadAfter` | list of up to 32 mod id, 4 to 64 characters (no repeats) | no | orders two mods that are both on; it adds no requirement |

## Phases

- Phases run in this order: base, profile, `content`, `patch`, `final`. A mod may use `content`, `patch` or `final`.
- Inside a phase, mods run in dependency and `loadAfter` order, then by id.
